notes.title: CRM – Overdue loan segmentation query
notes.code:
SELECT customer_id,
       loan_id,
       DATEDIFF(day, due_date, GETDATE()) AS days_overdue,
       outstanding_balance
FROM   loan_accounts
WHERE  status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND  DATEDIFF(day, due_date, GETDATE()) > 30
ORDER  BY days_overdue DESC;
notes.body: Use this to pull customers with DPD > 30 for the monthly NPL report. Pair with the MOB bucket logic.

notes.title: MOB bucket classification
notes.code:
SELECT customer_id,
       CASE
         WHEN mob BETWEEN 1  AND 3  THEN 'Early'
         WHEN mob BETWEEN 4  AND 6  THEN 'Mid'
         WHEN mob BETWEEN 7  AND 12 THEN 'Mature'
         ELSE 'Aged'
       END AS mob_bucket
FROM   customer_mob;
notes.body: MOB = Month on Book. Used in Last MOB campaign targeting.

notes.title: Sprint ticket escalation SOP
notes.body:
1. Identify blocker tickets (status = Blocked > 2 days).
2. Ping assignee on Teams with ticket link.
3. If no response within 4h, escalate to team lead.
4. Log escalation in TicketTracker sheet with timestamp.
5. Follow up next standup.

notes.title: DuPont decomposition – bank ROE
notes.body:
ROE = Net Profit Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier

ROE = (Net Income / Revenue) × (Revenue / Total Assets) × (Total Assets / Equity)

For Vietnamese banks:
- NIM drives NP margin
- Leverage (equity multiplier) is typically high (10–15x)
- Asset quality affects the margin leg (via credit loss provisions)

Apply CAMEL alongside to contextualise each component.

notes.title: CAMEL framework – VN banks
notes.body:
C – Capital Adequacy: CAR (Basel II/III compliance, SBV minimum 8%)
A – Asset Quality: NPL ratio, special-mention loans, LLR coverage
M – Management: governance scores, board independence (VCGS)
E – Earnings: ROA, ROE, NIM, CIR (Cost-to-Income)
L – Liquidity: LDR, short-term funding gap, SBV repo access

Note: SCB collapse (2022) is a canonical case of failure across A, M, L, H simultaneously.
